scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const f of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) fs.rmSync(f,{force:true}); const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if (process.env.CI==='true'||ua.startsWith('pnpm/')) process.exit(0); console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1);"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:prod: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); process.env.BASE_PATH ||= '/'; const result = spawnSync('corepack', ['pnpm', '--filter=!workspace', '--filter=!@workspace/mockup-sandbox', '-r', 'build'], { stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env, shell: process.platform === 'win32' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
